fresh_clean_independent_recheck.scope: Recorded physical trace, both candidates' values/actions, selection, state dtype+shape+bytes and PNG; not full latent-tensor parity

all30_descriptive.ranking_scope: Initial-query rate has one fixed physical state and two matched full action candidates per episode. Any-prefix flip is descriptive and stops at trajectory divergence; it is not an uncensored per-query flip rate.
all30_descriptive.uncertainty_scope: Exploratory fixed development panel. Bootstrap resamples tasks; sign-flip requires independent task effects with sign symmetry under the null (exact refers only to enumeration, not a randomized trial). Episode McNemar additionally assumes independent episodes, not established here. No population or independent generalization claim.
